verdict: Service connection point cannot download `ConfigMgr.AdminUIContent.cab` from the cloud. TLS 1.2 is not enabled for .NET Framework on the SCP host.
fix: On the SCP, enable TLS 1.2 for .NET: set `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\.NETFramework\v4.0.30319 SchUseStrongCrypto=1` (DWORD) and the Wow6432Node twin. Also set `SystemDefaultTlsVersions=1` at both locations. Reboot. Confirm outbound proxy exceptions allow `https://configmgrbits.azureedge.net` and `https://go.microsoft.com`. Consider upgrading the SCP host OS; Windows Server 2012 and earlier have weaker defaults.
